name: brotli CLI quality 5: 64 KiB random (incompressible)
ref: brotli -5 of 64 KiB seeded random bytes

name: corrupt: a flipped bit in the middle of the stream
ref: brotli -q 5 stream with one bit flipped (brotli -t rejects it)

name: corrupt: the window header byte
ref: brotli -q 5 stream with the first byte changed

name: input of no bytes is E_COERCE
not brotli: plain text is E_COERCE
ref: text that is not a brotli stream (brotli -t rejects it)

name: bomb: 256 MiB of zeros in a few hundred bytes stops at the limit
ref: brotli -q 5 -w 24 of 256 MiB zeros from stdin

name: 1 MiB of zeros (within the limit)
ref: brotli -q 5 of 1 MiB zeros from stdin
